blocks.zh: 瓊脂上的熱逆境開始，七天齡幼苗進 37 C，共四組

blocks.en: Set 8 ACCD pretest sown; agar salinity concentration testing
blocks.zh: 播下第 8 組 ACCD 預試；瓊脂鹽度濃度測試
第 7 組第 4 次開始

blocks.en: Set 8 trial 1 sown; heat stress agar fresh weight measured
blocks.zh: 播下第 8 組第 1 次；量測熱逆境瓊脂的鮮重
熱逆境瓊脂的葉綠素萃取

blocks.en: Soil ACCD trial relabelled into five arms and started; photographed to September 1
blocks.zh: 土壤 ACCD 試驗重新標示為五個處理組並開始；拍照記錄到 9 月 1 日

blocks.en: Set 8 pretest treatment begins, stopped after three days for bacterial growth on every ACCD plate
blocks.zh: 第 8 組預試處理開始，三天後因每個 ACCD 培養盤都長菌而中止

blocks.en: Set 7 trial 4 chlorophyll comes in: controls 0.2986, 0.2479 and 0.0690 across 0, 75 and 100 mM, computed with a third equation and two extraction volumes inside one trial
blocks.zh: 第 7 組第 4 次的葉綠素結果出來：0、75、100 mM 的對照分別為 0.2986、0.2479 與 0.0690，同一次試驗內用了第三種公式與兩種萃取體積計算

blocks.en: Plant check photographed; soil record deck runs to September 22
blocks.zh: 植株檢查拍照記錄；土壤紀錄簡報一直做到 9 月 22 日

blocks.en: Prof. Cheng Mei-Chun's laboratory at NTU: plastic boxes and foam boards with holes, the origin of the design
blocks.zh: Prof. Cheng Mei-Chun 在臺大的實驗室：打孔的塑膠箱與泡棉板，這個設計的起點

blocks.en: First hydroponics plate prototype photographed, three black perforated float plates labelled 1.5 L, 2 L and 300 mL
blocks.zh: 第一個水耕板原型拍照記錄，三片黑色打孔浮板分別標示 1.5 L、2 L 與 300 mL

blocks.en: First hydroponic holder poured: half MS agar into 1.5 mL tube lids with 3 mm punched holes, one seed per lid, vernalised three days at 4 C
blocks.zh: 第一批水耕載具灌製完成：半量 MS 瓊脂灌入打了 3 mm 孔的 1.5 mL 離心管蓋，每個蓋一粒種子，於 4 C 春化三天
架設好的水耕原型拍照記錄

blocks.en: First hydroponic medium preparations in the notebook
blocks.zh: 筆記中第一批水耕培養液的配製

blocks.en: Boxes A, B and C day 1, the first prototype comparison run, photographed daily to June 6 when box D joins
blocks.zh: A、B、C 三箱的第 1 天，第一次原型比較試驗，每天拍照到 6 月 6 日 D 箱加入

blocks.en: The full set of float plates made together by hand
blocks.zh: 全套浮板一起手工製作完成

blocks.en: Four-day-old seedlings moved from agar into prototype 4 under instructor supervision, the change that separated the one box that worked from the four that did not
blocks.zh: 在指導老師監督下把四天齡幼苗從瓊脂移入原型 4，這個改動就是那一個成功的箱與四個失敗的箱之間的差別

blocks.en: Day 1 of the plant record sheet for hydroponics
blocks.zh: 水耕植株紀錄表的第 1 天
第一次列印浮板的迭代

blocks.en: Seeds sown for set A and vernalised in the hydroponic system
blocks.zh: 播下 A 組種子，並在水耕系統中春化

blocks.en: 41 plants transferred from the tube rack onto three bleached 3D printed boards in three tip boxes, labelled Box 1, 2 and 3
blocks.zh: 41 株植物從管架移到三個槍頭盒裡經漂白的三片 3D 列印板上，標示為 Box 1、2、3

blocks.en: Issue of Box B1: the printed board sank because medium entered it, two lids contaminated by red bacteria or fungi, the medium turbid, 8 of 13 plants not growing
blocks.zh: Box B1 的問題：培養液進入列印板導致下沉，兩個管蓋被紅色細菌或真菌污染，培養液混濁，13 株中有 8 株沒有生長

blocks.en: Failed boxes taken apart seedling by seedling; prototypes 2 and 3 dropped
blocks.zh: 失敗的箱一株一株拆解檢查；原型 2 與 3 放棄

blocks.en: Box 4 made up with 600 microlitres CH Biotech protectant, plants moved across from boxes 1, 2 and 3; salinity set 1 starts
blocks.zh: Box 4 配入 600 微升 CH Biotech 保護劑，植株從 1、2、3 箱移過來；鹽度第 1 組開始

blocks.en: Medium changed on all four boxes, 600 microlitres CH protectant into box 1 and 10 mL of 3 M NaCl into all four, giving 100 mM on 13-day-old plants
blocks.zh: 四箱全部換液，600 微升 CH 保護劑加入 1 號箱，四箱各加 10 mL 的 3 M NaCl，使 13 天齡植株處於 100 mM

blocks.en: Seeds sown for set C and vernalised, for heat stress
blocks.zh: 播下 C 組種子並春化，用於熱逆境

blocks.en: Salinity set 1 harvested, chlorophyll and fresh weight on all four boxes
blocks.zh: 鹽度第 1 組採收，四箱都量葉綠素與鮮重

blocks.en: Visit to the YesHealth hydroponic farm; the dry lab was back on the hardware drawings the same day
blocks.zh: 參訪 YesHealth 水耕農場；乾實驗室當天就回到硬體圖面上

blocks.en: New seed set sown for the hydroponic system in 0.1x MS
blocks.zh: 為水耕系統在 0.1x MS 中播下新一批種子

blocks.en: Boxes C1 to C4 medium changed and CH protectant into C2 as pre-treatment
blocks.zh: C1 至 C4 箱換液，CH 保護劑加入 C2 作為前處理

blocks.en: Heat run starts, boxes at an incubator setting of 37 C and a measured 33 C, CH protectant into C3 as co-treatment
blocks.zh: 熱逆境試驗開始，培養箱設定 37 C、實測 33 C，CH 保護劑加入 C3 作為同時處理

blocks.en: C3 protectant removed and C4 dosed as post-treatment
blocks.zh: 移除 C3 的保護劑，C4 作為後處理給藥

blocks.en: Set F seeds sown for the hydroponic system
blocks.zh: 為水耕系統播下 F 組種子

blocks.en: Boxes D1 to D4 medium changed, CH protectant into D2 as pre-treatment
blocks.zh: D1 至 D4 箱換液，CH 保護劑加入 D2 作為前處理

blocks.en: Second heat run, heat box set to 50 C with a measured 35 C, CH protectant into D3 as co-treatment
blocks.zh: 第二次熱逆境試驗，加熱箱設定 50 C、實測 35 C，CH 保護劑加入 D3 作為同時處理

blocks.en: D3 protectant removed and D4 dosed as post-treatment
blocks.zh: 移除 D3 的保護劑，D4 作為後處理給藥

blocks.en: Progress report to Prof. Cheng, two boxes taken along; every box still contaminates, from prototype 1 to now
blocks.zh: 向 Prof. Cheng 報告進度，帶了兩個箱過去；從原型 1 到現在，每個箱都還是會污染

blocks.en: Hydroponics write-up lists a seventh prototype that is a plan only and records contamination among prototype 4's problems
blocks.zh: 水耕的書面紀錄列出第七個原型，但它只是計畫；並把污染記在原型 4 的問題之中

blocks.en: Hydroponics hardware page updated with measured geometry, bill of materials and print settings
blocks.zh: 水耕硬體頁更新了實測幾何、材料清單與列印設定

blocks.en: First growth test in the loop, paired with a serum bottle, sampled every 30 minutes; shell-side fluid plated and grew no colonies
blocks.zh: 迴路中的第一次生長測試，與血清瓶成對進行，每 30 分鐘取樣；shell 側液體塗盤後沒有長出菌落

blocks.en: Same run continued to 27 h: incubator 2.169 to 2.402, reactor 0.197 to 0.370, reservoir sample 0.480
blocks.zh: 同一次運轉持續到 27 h：培養箱 2.169 至 2.402，反應器 0.197 至 0.370，水箱樣本 0.480

blocks.en: Prototype 2 growth test with 200 rpm stirring at 37 C, reactor plateau OD600 0.8 to 0.9 at about 2 h, flask 0.6 to 0.8 at 4.5 h
blocks.zh: 原型 2 在 37 C、200 rpm 攪拌下的生長測試，反應器約 2 h 時 OD600 進入 0.8 至 0.9 的平台，搖瓶在 4.5 h 為 0.6 至 0.8

blocks.en: Prof. Chang finds the gap: no mechanism for getting protectant out of the membrane; suggests a valve after the membrane
blocks.zh: 張教授指出缺口：沒有任何機制能把保護劑從薄膜取出；建議在薄膜後加一個閥

blocks.en: Pressure sensor connected to Arduino with live data for the first time
blocks.zh: 壓力感測器第一次接上 Arduino 並即時傳回數據

blocks.en: Reactor running in the incubator with the serum bottle and plants on the shelf above
blocks.zh: 反應器在培養箱中運轉，血清瓶同在箱內，植株放在上層架上

blocks.en: 434 hour logging run begins, 2,671 valid rows at ten minute intervals at 22 C, to August 8; OD channel unusable from 243.0 h
blocks.zh: 434 h 的記錄運轉開始，在 22 C 下以十分鐘間隔取得 2,671 筆有效資料，持續到 8 月 8 日；OD 通道自 243.0 h 起無法使用

blocks.en: Pressure to flow rate sweep with the dry lab and instructors; second sweep August 14
blocks.zh: 與乾實驗室和指導老師一起做壓力對流量的掃描；第二次掃描在 8 月 14 日
新薄膜潤濕並測試

blocks.en: Jumper run: the pressure sweep repeated over the same eight pump settings with a plain jumper in place of the module, showing the rig's own resistance is 43 to 56 percent of the gauge reading
blocks.zh: 跳接運轉：以一段普通跳接管取代模組，在相同的八個幫浦設定上重做壓力掃描，顯示設備本身的阻力占壓力計讀值的 43 至 56%

blocks.en: Firmware build splits the OD measurement into a state machine; reactor monitored in the incubator
blocks.zh: 韌體版本把 OD 量測拆成狀態機；反應器在培養箱中監測

blocks.en: 102 hour perfusion run begins, to September 6: 12,259 rows of 30 s medians, hourly median OD600 0.84 to 3.77, loop flow near 371 mL/min
blocks.zh: 102 h 的灌流運轉開始，持續到 9 月 6 日：12,259 筆 30 s 中位數資料，每小時 OD600 中位數由 0.84 到 3.77，迴路流量接近 371 mL/min
指導老師監測反應器

blocks.en: The cartridge photographed upright in the reactor's case
blocks.zh: 濾芯在反應器機殼中直立的照片

blocks.en: First chlorophyll extraction entry with the full protocol written out, 10 plants per tube, 80 percent acetone, 3 wells per sample
blocks.zh: 第一筆寫出完整流程的葉綠素萃取紀錄，每管 10 株植物、80% 丙酮、每個樣本 3 個孔
葉綠素萃取
Arabidopsis 的鮮重

blocks.en: In-line photometer overreads the BioDrop about four-fold; traced to the blank
blocks.zh: 在線光度計比 BioDrop 高估約四倍；原因追到空白樣本
瓊脂第 6 組鮮重

blocks.en: Set 6 chlorophyll extraction; the 633 nm against 663 nm wavelength error found on this date
blocks.zh: 第 6 組葉綠素萃取；633 nm 與 663 nm 的波長錯誤在這一天被發現

blocks.en: Arabidopsis fresh weight; OD of hay infusion measured
blocks.zh: Arabidopsis 鮮重；量測乾草浸液的 OD
第 7 組第 1 次葉綠素萃取

blocks.en: New photometer calibration curve test prepared
blocks.zh: 準備新的光度計校正曲線測試
熱逆境瓊脂的鮮重

blocks.en: TiO2 linearity ladder, 2 to 60 mg into 400 mL with the BioDrop in parallel to 46 mg: 59 in-line readings and 45 BioDrop readings, ours = 1.018 x BioDrop minus 0.031, R2 0.995
blocks.zh: TiO2 線性階梯，2 至 60 mg 加入 400 mL，並以 BioDrop 平行量到 46 mg：在線讀值 59 筆、BioDrop 讀值 45 筆，我們的讀值 = 1.018 x BioDrop 減 0.031，R2 0.995
第 7 組第 4 次葉綠素讀出結果

blocks.en: First light-control assay on DiOPAL: OD600 at 2, 4, 6, 8 and 24 h across six light arms
blocks.zh: DiOPAL 上第一次光控檢測：六個光照組在 2、4、6、8 與 24 h 的 OD600
